attempted_claim: Let q=2 and p_c=sqrt(2)/(1+sqrt(2)) for FK random-cluster on Z^2. For each integer n with 4<=n<=256 let R_n=[0,2n]x[0,n] with induced edges and H_n be left-right open crossing, with free boundary conditions, P^{free}_{n} the critical measure at p_c. Prove 0.05<=P^{free}_{n}(H_n)<=0.95 for every such n. A complete answer proves this scale-uniform explicit window for all 253 scales from the fermionic-observable base estimate plus RSW gluing, or disproves it by exhibiting one n with a rigorous bound outside the window.
decisive_failure: Elementary rigorous envelopes (single-path domination, Bernoulli comparison, duality) miss the claimed window by orders of magnitude and in the wrong asymptotic direction; the quantitative fermionic-observable plus RSW program with explicit uniform constants over 253 scales was beyond this pass. No emergent finding is claimed and no alternative route passes Audit.
